key_insight: ActCam enables zero-shot joint control of both actor motion and per-frame camera parameters in video generation by building on pretrained image-to-video diffusion models and conditioning them on scene geometry and motion cues.
problem_solved: Existing video generation methods lack fine-grained, simultaneous control over actor performance and cinematography (camera intrinsics/extrinsics) without costly retraining or per-scene supervision.
method: Start from a pretrained image-to-video diffusion backbone that accepts scene geometry and motion conditioning (e.g., depth + pose/flow).
Provide a driving video for character motion and a target scene; condition each output frame on per-frame camera intrinsics/extrinsics and scene depth to steer both actor pose and camera trajectory.
Operate zero-shot (no finetuning) using conditioning and guidance mechanisms to preserve scene consistency while transferring motion and enforcing user-specified camera parameters.
impact: Enables artists and practitioners to generate cinematic videos with precise, per-frame control over both performance and camera movement without model retraining, accelerating creative workflows and prototyping in motion-centric applications.
